items.title: Razorpay Moves Closer to Public Listing with SEBI Approval for INR 6,000 Crore IPO
items.summary: SEBI has approved Razorpay’s IPO proposal of Rs 5,000-6,000 crore. The company is eyeing a valuation of about $5 billion. The fintech, which was established in 2014, has moved beyond payment processing into banking, payroll, finance, and commercial financial services.
items.author: Nitin Konde
